current_answer: Choose by frontend task, agent, source revision, and the instructions actually loaded. Before comparing outputs, confirm the target agent invoked the skill: in Claude Code, an installed skill body loads only when invoked, and a user-invocable skill can be called directly. For an existing screen, fix the route, real content, components, tokens, states, and viewports. Compare a pinned skill with the same no-skill brief on the same model and project. Judge visual-system fit and functional behavior separately, then note time and token cost. No listed skill has a pool-run no-skill outcome comparison.

catalogue_card.question: Installed a frontend skill. Did it actually run?
catalogue_card.text: Claude Code makes a skill available before its full instructions load. Confirm that the skill was invoked before attributing a screen to it. A skill call proves loading, not better design; no listed skill has a pool-run no-skill comparison.

summary: Choose by task, agent, pinned or declared mutable source, and instructions that actually loaded.
